The '''Circle of Lords''' was the unicameral legislative body of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. The Circle governed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] from the [[Circle Chambers]], a room located near the top of the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] of the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. The Circle was led by a [[Grand Lord]], seven [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lords]], and thirteen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]]. Although [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Masters]] did not hold an official spot on the Circle, they were also known to attend meetings. As of [[41 ABY]], the Grand Lord of the Circle was [[Darish Vol]]. Another of the Circle's influential members was Lady [[Olaris Rhea]], who led the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attack]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[43 ABY]].
